summary: Tolerated lateness after a job's window ends; overrides the global constraint value.
range: Non-negative integer seconds. Overrides options.constraint.max_visit_lateness for this job.
businessRules: Lateness within tolerance surfaces as steps[].late_by / summary.total_visit_lateness; beyond it -> unassigned.

max_visit_lateness defines: It determines the allowable delay, in seconds, to begin a job after its designated time window has concluded. Please note that this parameter would override the constraint.max_visit_lateness (globa…
Must stay consistent with: jobs.time_windows. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Rule: Shipments: pickup always occurs before delivery on the route.
Numeric field; verify sign (positive/negative) and unit from spec.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Positive: max_visit_lateness 600 lets a 5-min-late arrival still serve.
Infeasible: max_visit_lateness 0 with an unreachable window -> unassigned.
Interaction: Infeasible: job window [09:00,09:30], max_visit_lateness 0, nearest vehicle arrives 09:45 -> unassigned.
Interaction: Interaction: a long wait for a late window pushes route end past the shift -> unassigned (couples with max-duration-distance-cap).
Interaction: Shipment: delivery window [09:00,09:30], max_visit_lateness 15, nearest vehicle arrives 09:40 -> accepted within lateness.
Interaction: Break: break time_windows [12:00,13:00], vehicle arrives 12:30 -> break scheduled at 12:30.
